background_story: Elisabeth was a brilliant engineer with a passion for innovative design. She spent years working on a top-secret project, codenamed 'TEG' (Thermal Energy Generator). Her goal was to create a sustainable, portable device that could harness and convert thermal energy into electricity. After countless setbacks and sleepless nights, Elisabeth finally succeeded in building a functioning prototype. The TEG device was met with international acclaim, revolutionizing the way people thought about renewable energy. Elisabeth's groundbreaking invention earned her numerous awards and recognition, but more importantly, it improved the lives of millions of people around the world, providing access to clean energy and reducing carbon emissions. Her dedication to the TEG project was a testament to her perseverance and vision.
